content.text:
Anthony Fenech
Tigers beat writer
Detroit Free Press
(734) 752-9667
Twitter: @anthonyfenech
From: Bull, Kevin <kbull@freepress.com>
Sent: Wednesday, December 2, 2015 12:03 PM
To: Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com>; Birkett, David <dbirkett@freepress.com>
Subject: FW: Beer event info for tomorrow night 
 
Assume you guys saw this. There will be a reminder email today coming. There will be plenty of food so eat there. Basically plan on some pouring beer and taking part in some trivia. Should be fun. I will aim to be there around 6:45 myself.

From: Rosner, Aimie 
Sent: Tuesday, December 01, 2015 12:23 PM
To: Sharp, Drew <dsharp@freepress.com>; Selasky, Sue <sselasky@freepress.com>; Wright, Mandi <mrwright@freepress.com>; Rucker, Rashaun <rrucker@freepress.com>; Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com>; Seidel, Jeff <jseidel@freepress.com>; Birkett, David <dbirkett@freepress.com>; Kieliszewski, Kathy <kkieliszewski@freepress.com>; Anderson, Elisha <eanderson@freepress.com>
Cc: Snider, Sara <ssnider@michigan.com>; Woods, Ashley <awoods@freepress.com>; Allen, Robert <rallen@freepress.com>; Bull, Kevin <kbull@freepress.com>
Subject: Beer event info for tomorrow night
Thank you all for planning to attend and be part of the Detroit Free Press Craft Classic tomorrow night.
The event is at Great Lakes Culinary in Southfield.  The address is 24101 W. 9 Mile Rd.
The event is from 7pm-9pm.  We will have 9 booths with local breweries sampling their holiday brews, tons of food and an hour of trivia with a $500 Visa gift card prize.

We have your names as celebrity pourers.  We will be asking you to hang out at one of the tables and help pour 3 oz samples.  Guests will give you a ticket and you will give them a sample.  If you are pouring, if you could please plan to be there between 6:15-6:30, that would be great.  We will be showing you where you will be stationed and what you will be doing.   You will also have time to walk around as well.  We won’t keep you in the same spot all night.
If you have any questions, please feel free to email me, or call me on my cell at 248-212-5901.
